info.description: Microservice delegated toward user's schema management and it's business logic.
info.title: Factory-Chainline Users-Service API

patch.description: Activates a user's account using a provided activation code.

422.description: Unprocessable Entity - Invalid or expired code

post.description: Requests a new activation code to be sent to the user's email address.

200.description: OK - Successfully requested a new activation code

422.description: Unprocessable Entity - Service failed to process the request

post.description: Initiates a WebSocket connection to handle user login with real-time progress updates.
Handles user login through an external provider (not implemented).
post.summary: Login a user via an external provider

delete.description: Logs out the current user by invalidating their token (not implemented).

post.description: Initiates the password reset process by sending a code to the user's email.

422.description: Unprocessable Entity - Service failed to process the request

delete.description: Cancels an active password reset request (not implemented).

patch.description: Sets a new password for the user using a valid reset code.

parameters.description: Password reset code and new password
parameters.name: body

200.description: OK - Password has been reset successfully

422.description: Unprocessable Entity - Invalid code or other error

post.description: Requests a new password reset code to be sent to the user's email address.

200.description: OK - Successfully requested a new reset code

422.description: Unprocessable Entity - Service failed to process the request (e.g., user not found)

post.description: Initiates a WebSocket connection to handle user registration with real-time progress updates.
Handles user registration through an external provider (not implemented).
post.summary: Register a user via an external provider

post.description: Requests a new second factor code to be sent to the user.

200.description: OK - Successfully requested a new 2FA code

422.description: Unprocessable Entity - Service failed to process the request

post.description: Requests a new second factor code to be sent to the user.

200.description: OK - Successfully requested a new 2FA code

422.description: Unprocessable Entity - Service failed to process the request

patch.description: Verifies a user's account with a provided code, returning the user and a JWT.

422.description: Unprocessable Entity - Invalid or expired code

post.description: Requests a new verification code to be sent to the user.

200.description: OK - Successfully requested a new verification code

422.description: Unprocessable Entity - Service failed to process the request

get.description:
Checks if the application is alive and running. This is typically a lightweight check
to ensure the process is active and responsive.

Checks if the application is ready to serve traffic. This typically involves
verifying connections to critical dependencies like databases or message queues.

patch.description: Updates the authenticated user's additional details.

delete.description: Permanently removes the authenticated user's account. This action is irreversible.

patch.description: Updates the authenticated user's application settings (e.g., 2FA, night mode).
Updates the authenticated user's basic profile information (e.g., name, email).
